title: How many children chose each sweet?
description: A question from the book asks you to complete the sweets table so the teacher can buy the right number of each sweet. The video reads each row of tally marks, bundle by bundle, and checks the total.
teaching_notes: One idea: count each bundle as five, then add the loose strokes. Watch for children who count a bundle as four, or who miss a bundle in a long row.

source: Figure it Out: complete the table to help the teacher purchase the correct numbers of sweets
video_script.why: The child turns each row of tally marks into the number of children who chose that sweet.
video_script.substitution: none: the book's own sweets table
video_script.anchor: Ruhee's table of sweets and tally marks
video_script.payoff_line: Jalebi six, gulab jamun nine, gujiya thirteen, barfi three and rasgulla seven children.

final_answer.value: Jalebi 6, gulab jamun 9, gujiya 13, barfi 3, rasgulla 7
final_answer.spoken: jalebi six, gulab jamun nine, gujiya thirteen, barfi three and rasgulla seven

names.Ruhee: teacher who buys sweets by the class preferences

never_show: the final table with all five numbers filled
maths_rules: Jalebi: one bundle and 1 stroke, 5 + 1 = 6 (given in the book).
Gulab jamun: one bundle and 4 strokes, 5 + 4 = 9 (given in the book).
video_script.design: The book's table with five rows. Each row's tally marks are read into a number in the last column.

beats.on_screen: title card with the sweets table: five rows of tally marks, three of the number boxes empty

marks.scene: the title card arrives with the five rows
marks.blank: three number boxes light up as empty

narration: <bookmark mark='scene'/>This is a question from your book about the sweets table of Ruhee.
<bookmark mark='blank'/>Three of the number boxes are still empty.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>How many children chose each sweet?

beats.on_screen: the table and the question mark stay on the board

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

beats.on_screen: one bundle drawn with the number five beside it, and loose strokes beside it counted one by one

marks.loose: the loose strokes are counted one by one

narration: <bookmark mark='bundle'/>Each bundle with its line stands for five children.
<bookmark mark='loose'/>We count the bundles in fives, then add the loose strokes one by one.

beats.on_screen: Given: gujiya two bundles and 3 strokes; barfi 3 strokes; rasgulla one bundle and 2 strokes

marks.given: the three tally rows are written as the given

narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, the tally marks of gujiya, barfi and rasgulla, with jalebi and gulab jamun already done.

beats.on_screen: To find: the number of children for gujiya, barfi and rasgulla

marks.find: the line to find is written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to fill the three empty boxes.

marks.gujiya: two bundles are counted as five and five, then three strokes are added, and 13 is written in the box

narration: <bookmark mark='gujiya'/>Step one, gujiya has two bundles and three strokes.
Two bundles are ten, and ten plus three is thirteen.

marks.barfi: the three strokes are counted one by one and 3 is written in the box

narration: <bookmark mark='barfi'/>Step two, barfi has no bundle, only three strokes.
Barfi was chosen by three children.

marks.rasgulla: the bundle is counted as five, two strokes are added, and 7 is written in the box

narration: <bookmark mark='rasgulla'/>Step three, rasgulla has one bundle and two strokes.

marks.total: the five numbers are added in a line under the table

narration: <bookmark mark='total'/>Step four, add the five numbers to check the table.
Six, nine, thirteen, three and seven make thirty eight children in all.

beats.on_screen: Answer: Jalebi 6, gulab jamun 9, gujiya 13, barfi 3, rasgulla 7 children

marks.ans: the whole table is completed and boxed

narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>Jalebi six, gulab jamun nine, gujiya thirteen, barfi three and rasgulla seven children.
